content_zh:
最新网址：“滴，宿主年龄27，蹲坑累计10000小时，达到系统启动要求！”
“滴，咸鱼影视奋斗系统启动中……”
“滴，咸鱼影视系统启动成功。”
“滴，请咸鱼宿主选择穿越的影视！”
“滴，检测到宿主正在观看电视剧微微一笑很倾城，系统加载中……”
“滴，加载成功，穿越功能启动中……”
“什么鬼？！”一脸懵逼的王跃正在蹲坑刷抖音，刚刷到剪辑的电视剧微微一笑很倾城，就莫名其妙的听到一连串的“滴滴”声。
“p，至少让人擦完屁股，提上裤子啊。”王跃环顾四周，还好，还好，这里是厕所。这点很重要！！！
“王跃，赶紧的！球赛马上开始了！”突然听到门外的声音，王跃下意识的回应“马上的，马上！刘伟你等一下啊。”
王跃边提裤子，边接受系统的反馈信息。刚喊自己的是舍友刘伟，这个被他替代的人也是王跃，庆大计算机系大一新生。头悬梁，锥刺股的好不容易考上庆大，就彻底咸鱼了。
逃课到是不至于，就是绷紧的那根弦突然松弛下来，就没有目标，每天跟着同学浑浑噩噩的过日子。王跃穿越过的这天，正好是校篮球联赛。王跃作为重要的饮水机管理员，是不可或缺的！
“系统？”作为网文读者，穿越和系统两个词早已经司空见惯了。王跃赶紧学其他网文主角跟系统联系。
“系统？！”
“系统精灵？！”
这狗系统！不会是只管杀不管埋的系统吧？不是都有系统任务吗？说好的技能点呢？没有反馈是什么鬼？！
王跃到达球场的时候，场上已近开打了，观众席熙熙攘攘的几乎坐满了。王跃熟练的坐在饮水机旁边，听着后面几个肖奈的粉丝期待的言语。心里想着，还好没有像别的穿越系统，要是发布攻略女主任务。这个时候贝微微已经被闷骚的肖奈给关注了，就自己这样的咸鱼，和他正面对上，不就和小怪兽挑衅奥特曼么。
王跃浮想联翩的功夫，被刘伟推了一下。“想啥呢！今天这么多美女在后面呢。你不想上去表现一下吗？”
“你完了，你这觉悟离你离开系队已经不远了！”王跃岔开话题，故作高深的摇了摇头。
“啥？！你有啥内幕！”刘伟被吓了一跳，瞪着牛眼看着王跃。
“你想啊，这种机会，大二三四的师兄那个不想上去表现一番，你一个大一小萌新，不老老实实的陪着我看饮水机，你以为你是科比呢？”王跃一眼嫌弃的看了一眼刘伟。

“可以啊，老三！你竟然有这种觉悟。”刘伟狠狠的拍了王跃肩膀一巴掌，又恶狠狠的对王跃说，“那你和我说说，你偷偷往后面看啥呢？”
俩人唠嗑的功夫，后面的看台上的女生大致也知道今天肖奈不会来了，陆陆续续的走了好多人，看台上稀稀落落的没剩下几个了。
下半场确定了20分优势后，师兄们终于让萌新小学弟上场去蹦跶了几分钟。
王跃在原来的世界里篮球玩的也不错，穿越过来又年轻了几岁，感觉身体素质相当不错。在场上打了几个回合，那感觉就回来了。后面他就变身王不传，球到他的手里，要么进篮筐，要么听“哐当”。不管别人是啥感受，反正在那个刹那间王跃感觉自己就是“王·布莱恩特·跃”。
“王跃，你小子刚还说我不想进系队了，你刚才这表现是不想混了吧？”回宿舍的路上，刘伟拿毛巾擦着脸上的汗水，鄙视的给王跃翻了一个白眼。
“大老爷们，卖啥萌呢，刚听人说，比赛开始前，你对系花表白了？”王跃看着这个萌萌的大男孩，挺佩服和肖奈抢女人的勇气。
“窈窕淑女，君子好逑！”刘伟昂着头，一脸的嘚瑟！
“我总感觉你在作死的边缘不断的蹦跶！”王跃叹了一口气，颇为同情的拍了拍刘伟的肩膀。“你好好练球，不然会很惨！”
“你这逻辑让我总感觉哪里不对！”
“以后你就明白了！”
content_en:
Latest website address: "Hey, the host is 27 years old and has accumulated 10,000 hours of squatting, which meets the system startup requirements!"
"Hey, the Xianyu Film and Television Struggle System is starting..."
"Hey, the Xianyu Film and Television System started successfully."
"Hey, please choose a time-traveling movie and TV show!"
"Hey, it's detected that the host is watching the TV series Smile Away, the system is loading..."
"Hey, the loading is successful, the time-travel function is starting..."
"What the hell?!" Wang Yue, who was confused, was browsing Douyin. As soon as he caught the clip of the TV series Smile, he heard a series of "didi" sounds inexplicably.
"P, at least let someone wipe your butt and put up your pants." Wang Yue looked around, okay, okay, this is the toilet. This is very important! ! !
"Wang Yue, hurry up! The game is about to start!" Suddenly hearing a voice outside the door, Wang Yue responded subconsciously, "Right away, right away! Liu Wei, please wait a moment."
Wang Yue lifted his pants while accepting feedback from the system. The person who just called him was his roommate Liu Wei, and the person he replaced was also Wang Yue, a freshman in the Department of Computer Science at Qingda University. A person with a swollen head and a thorny butt finally got admitted to Qingda University and was completely screwed.
It's not that I skipped classes, but the tight string suddenly relaxed, and I had no goal and followed my classmates every day to live in confusion. The day Wang Yue traveled through happened to be the school basketball league. As an important water dispenser manager, Wang Yue is indispensable!
"System?" As a reader of online articles, the words time travel and system have long been commonplace. Wang Yue quickly imitated other online protagonists and contacted the system.
"System?!"
"System Elf?!"
This dog system! Isn't it a system that just kills people but doesn't bury them? Don’t they all have system tasks? What about the promised skill points? What the hell is no feedback? !
When Wang Yue arrived at the stadium, the game was about to start, and the auditorium was almost full. Wang Yue sat skillfully next to the water dispenser, listening to the expectant words of Xiao Nai's fans behind him. I thought to myself, luckily there is no guide to the heroine mission like other time travel systems. At this time, Bei Weiwei had already attracted the attention of the sultry Xiao Nai. For a salty fish like herself to face him head-on, wouldn't it be like provoking Ultraman with a little monster?
While Wang Yue was thinking about it, he was pushed by Liu Wei. "What are you thinking about? There are so many beauties behind you today. Don't you want to go up and show off?"
"You're done. You've realized that you're not far away from leaving the team!" Wang Yue changed the subject and shook his head pretending to be profound.
"What?! What kind of inside story do you have!" Liu Wei was startled and looked at Wang Yue with bull eyes.
"Think about it, this kind of opportunity, the seniors who are sophomores, juniors and seniors don't want to go up and show off, but you, a junior and a freshman, are not conscientiously accompanying me to look at the water dispenser. Do you think you are Kobe?" Wang Yue glanced at Liu Wei with disgust.
"Okay, third child! You actually have such awareness." Liu Wei slapped Wang Yue on the shoulder hard, and said to Wang Yue fiercely, "Then tell me, why are you secretly looking behind you?"
While the two were chatting, the girls in the stands behind them roughly knew that Xiao Nai would not be coming today. Many people left one after another, and there were only a few left in the stands.
After establishing a 20-point advantage in the second half, the seniors finally let the new junior come on the court to jump around for a few minutes.
Wang Yue was also good at basketball in his original world. After traveling back in time, he was a few years younger and felt that his physical fitness was quite good. After playing a few rounds on the court, the feeling came back. Later, he transformed into a passer. When the ball came into his hands, it would either go into the basket or hear a "clang". No matter how others feel, Wang Yue felt that he was "Wang Bryant Yue" at that moment.
"Wang Yue, you just said that I didn't want to enter.We are part of a team. Did you just show that you don’t want to be part of the team anymore? "On the way back to the dormitory, Liu Wei wiped the sweat from his face with a towel and rolled his eyes at Wang Yue with contempt.
"Big man, why are you so cute? I just heard someone say that before the game started, you confessed your love to Xihua? "Wang Yue looked at this cute boy and admired his courage to compete with Xiao Nai for a woman.
"My fair lady, the gentleman is so brave! "Liu Wei held his head high, with a look on his face!
"I always feel like you are constantly on the verge of death! "Wang Yue sighed and patted Liu Wei on the shoulder sympathetically. "You practice hard, otherwise it will be miserable! "
"Your logic always makes me feel like something is wrong! "
"You will understand later! "
